parameters.name: DataQualityScanId
parameters.description: The ID of the data quality monitoring task.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The parameter settings used during the actual run. The `triggerTime` parameter is required.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The parameter name. Currently supported parameter:
- triggerTime

Other scheduling parameters are not supported.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The parameter value:
- If the parameter name is triggerTime, the value must be the timestamp of the scheduling time.

parameters.name: RuntimeResource
parameters.description: The schedule resource group used when the data quality monitoring task runs. This shares the same data structure as the scheduling API.
